# Review — secret-history-172-176

## Pass 1

Reviewer pass 1 (adversarial). Units are numbered U0–U76 in order, 0-based, each given by its first word; word indices are global (0–448). `t` text, `p`/`ln` marks and coverage (449 words, once, in order) were checked by script against `packet.md` after editing: all intact; every Ming bracket in a morph gloss equals the packet's Ming gloss (the three empty ones, lerün/abi/babi, carry none). Names were normalised to the house forms of 043-054, 125-130, 151-153 and 170-171.

### Findings refused

| Where | Finding | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| U1 w5 | 'Chinggis's third son' in the gloss of Ögödei | Outside the Ming and not a translation; true, harmless, and the same gloss form as in earlier parts. Left. |
| U10 i | 'was seen coming' passive | Reasonable English for the viewpoint of üžeġesü in unit 9; no grammar is misrepresented. Left. |
| U18 split | Cut after qaγačaqu. and irebe. (Shiratori's full stops) | The first stop falls inside the noun phrase 'the track of our parting and going out'; splitting would break the sense and the units' sense-cut. Kept as one unit; noted as a doubt. |
| U41/42 i | 'It was provoked as provoking goes' (and 'fought as fighting goes') are awkward | Literal and unresolved in the Ming; a smoother wording would invent a subject. Left. |
| U49 i | 'the son born to us thus far' | Note already flags it as uncertain (edün törün baraγsan); no better reading from the grammar. Left; listed as a doubt. |
| U49/56 i | asaraja 'look after' versus asaradqun 'carry' | Both render Ming 擡擧 'raise'; context allows 'cherish' in 49 and 'lift' in 56, and l keeps 'raise' in both. Left. |
| U70 n | '-ten … the same ending as in itegelten' | Both are the plural of -tei/-tü; the Ming functions differ (等 / 有的) but the identification is sound and hedged. Left. |
| U72 i | 'As he sent him' against Ming 去時 'at going' | The glossary already records both readings for ilerün; l and the note agree with i. Left. |
| U36 i | 'Moving on, they went up…' merges ködölürün and ködölüġed | Both converbs are carried (moving / having set out) and the sentence is readable; no force lost. Left. |
| U27/U56 morph | alžaγ̇ad (lemma alžaγ̇a-) and alžaγ̇üžai (alžaγ̇ü-) are probably one root | The vowel difference is in the print and both stems are marked inferred; unifying would be a guess. Left; listed as a doubt. |
| U60/61 n | Word order 'numeral before leader' called unusual | Observation, not an error. Left. |
| all | Pronoun 'he' for unmarked subjects in i | Chronicle style needs a subject; checked each against its note and kept only where the note names or implies one. |

### Summary

**Summary.** 65 changes logged: critical 0, major 16, minor 36, nit 13 (changes that touch several fields of one unit are logged once; the global morph normalisation is one entry). Nothing critical: no label contradicted the form in a way that changed a translation's whole sense, but sixteen major items remained: i-versus-l/grammar failures (hortative turned future at U7, U29, U35; the comitative at U3; invented subjects and objects at U11, U16, U18, U21; Wang Qan's report at U39–40; the praying at U48; the Mongols with Jamuqa at U50; omitted tende at U53; the Ongirad speech at U73–74) and the atala analysis at U19. The names now follow house spelling (Kereid, Ongirad, Uruqud, Mongqud, Shilügeljid, Büyür). Remaining doubts: (1) U15–U17, Bo'orchu's account of the gap, the pack-horse and the verb that governs -ji, are still a first reading; (2) U18 carries three of Shiratori's full stops in one sense-unit; (3) U33 and U34 (who comes, who dodges; dain-a is a dative); (4) U39–U45, whether Wang Qan's speech begins at U41 and ends at U44 and who 'we' is; (5) U48 abi/babi (no Ming gloss); (6) U49 'born … thus far'; (7) U53 the full stop after tende; (8) U56–U57 the quotation closing after ičuba; (9) U65 who urges whom, the dative on Qaγan-(n)a; (10) U69 hužaγ̇ur as the Qalqa's mouth; (11) U73–U74 the Ongirad's two-option speech and the object of ileġesü; (12) alžaγ̇ad / alžaγ̇üžai as one root; (13) the 'Uruqud' of this part against the 'Uru'ud' clan of 043-054 may be the same body or not.
